An '''RA-7 protocol droid''' served on board [[Gideon's light cruiser]] in [[9 ABY]]. During the [[Second rescue of Grogu]], the droid was roaming the halls of the light cruiser when the [[Mandalorian]] [[Din Djarin]] hid himself to avoid detection by the droid.<ref name="Chap16" />

==Behind the scenes==
The RA-7 protocol droid first appeared in "[[Chapter 16: The Rescue]]", the final episode of [[The Mandalorian Season Two|second season]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', where it was portrayed by [[Chris Bartlett]].<ref name="Chap16" />
